label: IA-4(6)
title: Cross-organization Management

statement.prose: Coordinate with the following external organizations for cross-organization management of identifiers: {{ insert: param, ia-04.06_odp }}.

guidance: Cross-organization identifier management provides the capability to identify individuals, groups, roles, or devices when conducting cross-organization activities involving the processing, storage, or transmission of information.

params.label: external organizations
guidelines: external organizations with whom to coordinate the cross-organization management of identifiers are defined;
